utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Quinn, that's good you've got tools, but we still need a headcount. If we don't hear from everyone by tomorrow, we might have to shift the start time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can be there, Pia. Just let me know when it starts.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey. That's one more confirmed. But I'm still waiting on half the list — maybe we should send a reminder text tonight.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: So Quinn, you heard about the repair drive this weekend? They're fixing up bikes for the kids Saturday morning, rain or shine!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yeah, I'm totally in! I've been telling everyone to come out and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That's awesome, Quinn! I knew I could count on you to spread the word. See you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, so it's this Saturday? I'd love to help out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, this Saturday! Faye mentioned it starts at 10 with coffee at 9:30. Want to meet up beforehand?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure, meeting up first sounds great! Where should we meet?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: You know, Dane, the repair drive is definitely this weekend. I'm bringing my old lawnmower.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, this weekend? I thought it was next weekend. Well, I did tell Cleo I could grab some nails and lumber tomorrow morning. That might still help out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, it's this weekend for sure, Dane. Your nails and lumber would be perfect for the drive — bring 'em along!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hey Bo, could you tell me more about the repair drive? I want to make sure I have the right details before we proceed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I heard something about that. Hope it works out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks Bo, but I need a bit more detail — do you recall when it stopped working, or who last used it? I want to double-check before we move forward.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It's shaping up nicely—just yesterday three more folks offered to help out. Are you thinking of joining us?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it's definitely happening? I still haven't seen an official flyer or anything—are we sure this is for real?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, it's real alright! I've been coordinating with the community center and we're just waiting on the final printed flyers. But I can put your name down right now if you'd like.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, I like to keep things on track — let's check back with Opal to confirm the location before we commit to a time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Good thinking, Eli — I'll head over to Opal's place now and see what she says about the spot.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'll wait here and mark off the time on my calendar once you've got the details from Opal.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, 9:30 for coffee sounds great—I'll drop the kids at soccer and head straight over.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have you heard anything about the repair drive yet? I was wondering if we're still waiting on those parts.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, it's next Saturday starting at 10 AM, but Jules said there's coffee and donuts at 9:30 if you want to come early. I'm planning to pop by after soccer drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Opal! Good timing — Ira just reminded me about the repair drive. I think I put my screwdriver set aside somewhere...

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Well, Eli mentioned the schedule says it'll be by the old oak tree around noon, so if you're looking to drop off that screwdriver, that's where you'll want to head.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: By the old oak tree, noon. Right, right — I'll try to remember that. Wait, I think I might've left my screwdriver in the shed...

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Noah, I keep hearing folks mention the repair drive—any chance you know what's actually happening with it?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, maybe... wait, is that this weekend or next? Vik was saying something about it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Not sure myself, Noah—I just caught Oren saying he put a screwdriver set aside for it, so maybe it's this Saturday after all.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, Dane's already offered to pick up more nails and lumber tomorrow — that should help a lot. How're we doing on old electronics?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We've got a decent stack of old phones and a couple of broken tablets, but I could use some help sorting which ones are worth fixing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help sort through them — I've got a multimeter and some basic repair tools. Let's check which ones just need new batteries or charging ports.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Need any tools for the repair drive? I've got a full set in my garage if you need to borrow anything.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I'm good on tools, but could use a hand loading these into the truck.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can give you a hand with that. Just let me grab my work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: So Rosa, are you bringing anything to the repair drive? It's this weekend for sure — I saw it on the community board.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I sure am! I've got a couple of hammers and a level I'm donating, plus I'll be there to help coordinate.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I'm bringing my old lawnmower — see you there!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, I need to know a solid time for those tools — was it noon or later?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm still waiting on three replies, Eli. Can we push the tool handoff to 1 PM to be safe?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me. I'll be there at 1 PM sharp with everything ready.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Nell, I've got some time after the weekend if that's still good for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that's great! I think it's about collecting tools and offering free repairs. I'm still figuring out the details, but I'd love to help out.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sounds good. Just let me know when and where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I'm sorry, I keep mixing up the dates. Could you remind me when it is again?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: It's this weekend, I think? But honestly, I'm still waiting for someone to confirm it's actually happening.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: This weekend? I thought it might be next weekend, but I'm not sure. I've got my tools ready just in case.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got the drills and laptop in the truck. Need a hand tying them down?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can give you a hand. But tell me more about this repair drive—I'm still figuring it out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's a community thing—folks drop off broken gear, we fix it up and donate. Grab that strap, will you?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Ira, are you thinking about joining the repair drive too? I heard they could use some extra help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I've heard folks talking about it, but I'm not really sure what all's involved. You know more about it?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It's a community thing where folks bring broken items and we help fix 'em up together. Mara mentioned they're going well but could use extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Mara, I just wanted to check if you or the team need any tools for the repair drive. I've got a torque wrench and socket set ready to go if needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's very thoughtful, Gus! Actually, Jules just offered to help too. Maybe we can all meet up and see what tools are needed. Your torque wrench and socket set sound great.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds like a plan, Mara. Just give me a shout when you want to round up the gear—I'll bring whatever's needed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Mina, if you have any old electronics or spare parts lying around, we could really use them for the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have we even scheduled the repair drive yet, or are we still waiting on parts?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We're still gathering supplies, but Dane offered to pick up nails and lumber from the hardware store tomorrow, so we might be able to set a date soon.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Tess, have you seen where the repair drive set up today? I'm trying to figure out if it's at the old garage or somewhere else.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I think it's at the community center, not the garage. I saw a flyer there saying Saturday morning, rain or shine.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hmm, the community center? That's a different spot than what I was thinking. Did you actually see their van there this morning?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, this weekend. I'll try to remember to bring something... maybe that broken toaster.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: A broken toaster? Perfect! We're collecting all kinds of things to fix up. I'll add you to my list for Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, Saturday? I thought it was Sunday. Let me check my calendar real quick.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Alright, I'll grab that laptop and meet you at the truck.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good, I'll see you there after I drop the kids off.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Alright, I'll head over to the truck now and start sorting through the stuff. See you in a bit!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Hana, I heard we're short on supplies for the repair drive. I can hit the hardware store tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane. Before you go, can you tell me exactly which supplies you think we're short on?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Cleo mentioned we're low on nails and lumber, so I'll grab those.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
